# FiguredOutAI

> FiguredOutAI (also written FiguredoutAI or Figured Out AI; legal name FiguredoutAI LLP) is an AI solutions provider and AI-native infrastructure partner for businesses worldwide. It designs, builds and runs AI agents, workflow automation, custom software and the infrastructure underneath them, and builds the FiguredOutAI Unified AI Sales Platform.

## Company facts
- Name: FiguredOutAI
- Also written: FiguredoutAI, Figured Out AI, FiguredOut AI
- Legal entity: FiguredoutAI LLP, LLPIN ACZ-0822, registered under the LLP Act 2008, India
- Founders: Tanishk Singhal (Co-founder & CEO), Yashvardhan Awasthi (Co-founder & CTO)
- Headquarters: India; remote-first, serving clients worldwide
- Website: https://figuredoutai.com
- Contact: hello@figuredoutai.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/figuredout-ai/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/figuredoutai/

## What FiguredOutAI does
- Custom AI agents and multi-agent systems
- Workflow automation
- Custom software, built AI-first
- AI infrastructure and LLMOps (deployment, evaluation, observability, cost control)
- Data, RAG and knowledge systems
- Conversational and voice AI
- AI-produced content
- Workforce management software
- FiguredOutAI Unified AI Sales Platform: one AI inbox for every sales channel (WhatsApp, Instagram, email, web, forms) with intent scoring, routing and white-label support for agencies

## How engagements work
Four milestone-gated phases (discover, architect, build and validate, operate), each approved by the client before it starts. Clients own the code, prompts and business logic. Model-agnostic: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini and open-source models.
